steps.note: Milk is warmed to bring the cream up, which must have at least 55 % fat.
Scalded without boiling, for at least an hour, while a thick crust forms.
The crust hardens and the cream beneath it thickens.

links.name: Cornish Clotted Cream, product specification (UK government, Defra)

sources.text: The scalding, cooling and fat figures are from the Cornish PDO specification; the article adds the traditional pan and water-bath methods.
